description: Record a post-scan conversion event (purchase, signup, etc.) for a QR code you own. Use this to track ROI — e.g., when a user scans a QR code and then makes a purchase, record a 'purchase' conversion with the order value. For client-side tracking without code, use the tracking pixel: .

event.description: The conversion event name (e.g., "purchase", "signup", "add_to_cart"). Use consistent names to aggregate stats.

metadata.description: Optional JSON metadata (e.g., product ID, order number).

short_id.description: The short_id of the QR code this conversion is for.

value.description: Optional monetary value of the conversion (e.g., 49.99).

name: record_conversion
